newsitem.title: USA: U.S. FERC to rule on PEPCO, BGE merger April 16.
newsitem.headline: U.S. FERC to rule on PEPCO, BGE merger April 16.

text.p: The U.S. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission plans to rule April 16 on the proposed merger of Baltimore Gas and Electric Co and Potomac Electric Power Co, according to a meeting agenda released Wednesday.
The companies are awaiting approvals from the FERC, the District of Columbia Public Service Commission, and the Maryland Public Service Commission for their merger to form Constellation Energy.
The FERC last year called for a hearing on the merger, raising concern that it would stifle competition locally.
The merger would form one of the largest utilities in the country, worth $15 billion.
